title: Stop and remove only your practice container
summary: Cleanup should target the exact resource you created. Stopping a container is separate from removing it.
introduction: Cleanup should target the exact resource you created. Stopping a container is separate from removing it. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain stop and remove only your practice container
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Cleanup should target the exact resource you created. Stopping a container is separate from removing it.

blocks.code:
docker stop club-web
docker rm club-web
blocks.title: Stop and remove only your practice container

blocks.text: The named practice container stops and is removed. Images and unrelated containers remain.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Run docker ps -a to confirm the named container is gone.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not use broad prune commands on a shared machine while learning.
For more detail later, use this [Docker further reading](https://docs.docker.com/get-started/).
